body:
## Pull request overview

Removes deprecated custom UI wrappers and consolidates ObjectUI onto Shadcn’s standard form patterns and Sonner-based toasts.

**Changes:**
- Removed legacy form wrappers (`field.tsx`, `input-group.tsx`) in favor of Shadcn `form.tsx` + Tailwind utilities.
- Removed Radix-based toast system (`toast.tsx`, `toaster.tsx`, `use-toast.ts`) and migrated toast/toaster renderers to Sonner.
- Updated package exports to drop removed modules and expose Sonner’s `Toaster`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 9 out of 9 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/components/src/ui/toaster.tsx | Deleted legacy Radix toast container component. |
| packages/components/src/ui/toast.tsx | Deleted legacy Radix toast primitives. |
| packages/components/src/hooks/use-toast.ts | Deleted legacy toast state/hook implementation. |
| packages/components/src/ui/input-group.tsx | Deleted custom input-group wrapper in favor of Tailwind layout. |
| packages/components/src/ui/field.tsx | Deleted custom field system in favor of Shadcn form patterns. |
| packages/components/src/ui/index.ts | Removed exports for deleted modules; added Sonner toaster export. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/feedback/toaster.tsx | Updated renderer to always render Sonner toaster. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/feedback/toast.tsx | Updated renderer to trigger Sonner toasts. |
| packages/components/src/index.ts | Removed re-export of deleted `use-toast` hook. |
</details>

`index.ts` re-exports `Toaster` twice (`export * from './sonner'` already includes it, and then `export { Toaster } from './sonner'`). This can trigger a duplicate export error in TS/ESM. Remove the explicit `export { Toaster } ...` line, or drop the `export * from './sonner'` and only re-export the symbols you want.
```suggestion

```

The `toaster` renderer now ignores `ToasterSchema` entirely and registers no configurable inputs. `@object-ui/types` defines `ToasterSchema.position` and `ToasterSchema.limit`, so schema-driven configuration will be silently dropped. Pass `schema.position` / `schema.limit` through to the Sonner `<Toaster>` (e.g., map `limit` to Sonner's `visibleToasts` if applicable) and expose these fields in `inputs`/`defaultProps`, or remove them from the schema contract.

The `toast` renderer only forwards `title`, `description`, and `duration` into Sonner and ignores other fields that are part of `ToastSchema` in `@object-ui/types` (notably `position`, `action`, and `onDismiss`). Either implement these schema fields with the Sonner API (e.g., `action`/`cancel` callbacks and dismissal handling, and/or position via the Toaster) or remove/mark them unsupported to avoid a schema/renderer mismatch.
```suggestion
        duration: schema.duration,
        position: schema.position,
        action: schema.action,
        onDismiss: schema.onDismiss,
```
